active.emptyFiltered: No active alerts match these filters.
active.ackedHint: Acked arrives from your on-call tool (PagerDuty / JSM). Yagra shows it and never sets it.
active.muteHint: Silence notifications for this check on this node until a time you choose

row.poolSubjectHint: This alert is about Yagra's own monitoring coverage, not a device: the pool still has nodes assigned to it but no live poller to poll them.
row.merakiOrgSubjectHint: The Cisco Meraki Dashboard API is not answering this organization, so nothing is being collected for its devices. Each device keeps the last state that was collected; this one alert stands for all of them.

acked.title: Acknowledged in {{source}} by {{by}}{{note}} (read-only, mirrored from your external tool)

events.note: Received syslog / SNMP-trap / webhook events. Unmatched events are kept for 24h to help author rules; matched events follow the alert-history retention.
events.listeningNone: No syslog or trap listener is bound. Set YAGRA_SYSLOG_BIND / YAGRA_TRAP_BIND on a poller to receive them; webhook senders are configured under Webhook sources.
events.emptyWindow: No events in the last 24 hours. The window is what keeps searching fast — widen it under When.
events.emptyPrefixMiss: No word starts with that here. This deployment matches from the start of a word, so a term that sits inside a longer one finds nothing — switch the message filter to Regex.
events.widened: No word starts with that term, so these are the events with it anywhere inside a word.

eventLog.emptyNode: No events received from this node yet.
eventLog.emptyNodeWindow: No events from this node in the last 24 hours. Widen the window under When.
